episodes.name: Trust Metric
episodes.overview: After the events of "The Janus List," Colby escapes from custody.  Don and the team go after him, but everything may not be as it seems.

episodes.name: Hollywood Homicide
episodes.overview: An actor on his way to stardom finds himself in the middle of a murder investigation when a young woman is murdered in his house.

episodes.name: Velocity
episodes.overview: When a car crashes into a busy coffee shop, the team discovers the fatal act might not have been an accident.

episodes.name: Thirteen
episodes.overview: Don, Charlie, and the team attempt to stop a serial killer who is seemingly obsessed with people resembling Biblical figures.

episodes.name: Robin Hood
episodes.overview: Robberies the storybook hero would have been proud to claim plague Don and Charlie as they attempt to catch a do-good thief who is donating his spoils to charity.

episodes.name: In Security
episodes.overview: Don feels responsible for a life lost.  The victim was in the Witness Protection Program, but she wasn't the only one keeping secrets...what is Don hiding?

episodes.name: Primacy
episodes.overview: When a man is found dead, the team enters the world of alternate reality gaming.  However, their investigation leads to a danger for a loved one.

episodes.name: Tabu
episodes.overview: When a wealthy heiress is kidnapped, Don and the team race against the clock in hopes to find her.  However, the motivations behind her disappearance aren't what they seem.

episodes.name: Graphic
episodes.overview: The team investigates the theft of a graphic comic book.

episodes.name: Chinese Box
episodes.overview: Don and the team are left with little recourse when a former FBI subcontractor takes a team member hostage.

episodes.name: Breaking Point
episodes.overview: Charlie's life is put in danger when Don brings him in on the case of a missing reporter.

episodes.name: Power
episodes.overview: A bad case becomes worse when Don and the team must pursue a police officer believed to have committed unspeakable crimes.

episodes.name: Black Swan
episodes.overview: Don and the team bust a meth lab, but when Don has a feeling there's more to the organization than just what's on the surface, his intuition is put to the test.

episodes.name: Checkmate
episodes.overview: Don runs into Robin Brooks during an investigation concerning informants and a chess master.

episodes.name: End Game
episodes.overview: Don and his team hunt for an ex-Marine wanted for murder.  Things become confusing, however, when the Marine's family is kidnapped.  Is there more to this case than meets the eye?

episodes.name: Atomic No. 33
episodes.overview: Don and the team must investigate a religious cult after scores of followers are poisoned.

episodes.name: Pay to Play
episodes.overview: When a musician is murdered, Don and his team must race to find the culprits.  They need Charlie's help, but he is busy with Amita's parents coming for a visit.

episodes.name: When World's Collide
episodes.overview: In the season finale, Don and Charlie work together on a case that ends up with them going head to head about their personal beliefs, and one team member will walk away forever.
